notes.title: Wonderstries 0.1.2
notes.notes: [p]In this patch we have addressed quite a few bugs, ranging from low impact to high impact, added a few features and changed a few things to feel better / more natural. Hope you enjoy! Please find the patchnotes below:[/p][list][*][p]FIXED A BUG WHERE THE PURIFICATION CHAMBER CAUSED GAME-BREAKING GLITCH[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED A BUG WHERE THE CRAFTING SYSTEM WAS TAKING ITEMS AND NOT DELIVERING THE CRAFTED ITEM DUE TO A FULL HOTBAR[/p][/*][*][p]FOOTSTEP SOUNDS ARE NOW BOUND TO THE MASTER VOLUME SLIDER IN SETTINGS[/p][/*][*][p]PLAYER ANIMATOR WILL NOW CONSISTENTLY FALLBACK TO THE STANDING STATE WHEN THE PLAYER STOPS MOVING[/p][/*][*][p]DESTRUCTION PROGRESS BAR AND PARTICLES WILL NOW DISAPPEAR WHEN THE PLAYER STOPS DESTROYING TREES, ALIGNING THE BEHAVIOUR WITH THE OTHER OBJECTS, SUCH AS MACHINES / CRATES[/p][/*][*][p]KEYBINDING MENU IS NOW ACCESSIBLE FROM THE OPTIONS MENU[/p][/*][*][p]    PREVIOUS BUTTON WILL TAKE YOU BACK TO THE OPTIONS MENU[/p][/*][*][p]    KEYBINDING ARE NOT CURRENTLY ABLE TO BE EDITED[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED A BUG THAT WAS PREVENTING STORAGE CRATES FROM DROPPING THEIR CONTENTS[/p][/*][*][p]STORAGE CRATES NOW CHECK THAT THE RECEIVING INVENTORY HAS SPACE BEFORE TRANSFERRING ITEMS[/p][/*][*][p]ADDED AN AUTOSAVE FEATURE THAT SAVES THE WORLD EVERY 5 MINUTES[/p][/*][*][p]DESTROYING A MACHINE WILL NOW CORRECTLY SET THE TILE(S) BELOW IT TO A DAMAGED STATE (DIGGERS ARE THE EXCEPTION, THEY WILL LEAVE THE TILES AS THEY WERE)[/p][/*][*][p]DESTROYING A CONVEYOR BELT OR CRATE WILL NOT SET THE ORE TILE TO THE DIRTY STATE, HOWEVER THERE IS A BUG WE ARE AWARE OF WHERE IT IS BOTH DESTROYING THE CONVEYOR BELT AND MINING THE TILE, IT WILL SET THE TILE TO DAMAGED AS IF YOU MINED IT, TO BE ADDRESSED IN 0.1.3[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED A BUG WHERE CONVEYORS WOULD NOT SPAWN ITEMS WHEN PULLING FROM AN INVENTORY[/p][/*][*][p]TIGHTENED UP ITEM IMPORT AND EXPORT RADIUS FOR CONVEYORS (THEY LOOK MORE NATURAL NOW)[/p][/*][/list][p]Much love from Altered Pixel Games <3[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Wonderstries 0.1.1 hotfix
notes.notes: [list][*][p]The drop-shadow is now being rendered underneath the player model[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When opening the console via '`' (Tilde) or '/' (forwardslash) all currently playing player animations and sound effects will be paused.[/p][/*][*][p]When crafting an item, the crafting system will now ensure the player has room in their hotbar to receive the item[/p][/*][*][p]Occasionally the held item was not visible. Held item will now always be visible[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting button next to hotbar will now toggle the crafting menu correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Options menu has been added to the title screen and syncs with the in-game options menu[/p][/*][*][p]Typing into the console in chat mode (`) will now save the message in the console. NOTE: console chat and commands are currently not synced across the server. Although in a future update we plan to have the chat messages synced between all players in the world[/p][/*][*][p]Player animations are now correctly reflected across all clients[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a client would not be able to successfully join a server[/p][/*][*][p]Storage crate's inventory will now close when the player walks away[/p][/*][*][p]Switch scroll and alternate scroll so the main behaviour is scrolling through the hotbar, holding CTRL+scrolling will zoom the camera[/p][/*][*][p]Added the options menu to the title screen so you do not have to load a world to adjust settings[/p][/*][*][p]Removed functionality that was preventing players from dropping items when in the presence of a crate or machine[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the information panel to contain hints on what items / tools will be helpful for dealing with things such as clearing damaged tiles, mining ores and destroying objects[/p][p][/p][p]NOTE: Server functionality is currently broken, you can still join worlds, however, some functionality is still bugged. While this patch addresses some of the broken server functionality, we are aware of some bugged features and are working on a server-side patch that will be released shortly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Much love from Altered Pixel Games <3[/p]
